Lemma
[Cauchy--Schwarz inequality in a Hilbert space] ↗ lem:cauchy-schwarz-inequality ↗ def:inner-product ↗ def:norm-from-inner-product 1. appD:D.2-lem-1\group Functional Analysis

For $u,v\in H$, \[ (2)\qquad |(u,v)|\leq \| u\| \| v\| . \] This is the inner-product form of equation lem:cauchy-schwarz-inequality.

The Cauchy--Schwarz inequality and the inner-product axioms imply that (1) is a norm.
